headline: Brazil Stocks Plunge 13.9% Following Lula Election Victory
summary: Brazil’s main stock index fell 13.88% in a single session following Lula's victory, marking its biggest drop since 2020 while the real depreciated.
why: Significant political shifts in Latin America's largest economy often trigger capital flight and sharp currency fluctuations, impacting emerging market portfolios.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Broader political shifts and market reactions led to a sharp drop in domestic equities and currency depreciation.

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding the economic policies of the incoming administration triggered widespread equity sell-offs and a depreciation of the Brazilian real.
